The new C E Ferulic has a patent-pending reformulation, but the original patent expired in 2025 and cannot simply be renewed. The new formula keeps the core 15% L-ascorbic acid, 1% vitamin E, and 0.5% ferulic acid, and adds 0.3% carnosine ,1% Endophytol and 0,01 eperuline.
So if you’re comparing bottles, check the label: the newer one lists carnosine and Endophytol. It’s still fundamentally the same vitamin C–E–ferulic antioxidant serum, with two additions.

Precise placement and experience can impact both the quality and longevity of your results.⁠

Meet Sculptra — our newest injectable treatment at Laserbody MD ✨⁠
If you’ve been hearing the name but aren’t quite sure what it actually does, this post breaks it all down.⁠
⁠
Sculptra isn’t a traditional dermal filler. It’s a collagen-stimulating injectable designed to help your skin rebuild its own support system over time. Instead of placing instant volume, it works gradually to improve skin firmness, structure, and overall volume in a very natural way.⁠
⁠
🧬 What makes Sculptra different?⁠
It targets collagen loss, which is one of the main reasons skin starts to look thinner, less firm, or less lifted as we age. By encouraging new collagen production, results develop slowly and can last up to two years or more.⁠
⁠
✨ Best for:⁠
• Soft, global facial volume loss⁠
• Skin quality and firmness⁠
• Clients who want subtle, long-term results⁠
• A natural “refreshed” look (not instant change)⁠
⁠
💉 Sculptra vs filler:⁠
They serve different purposes. Fillers are ideal for immediate shaping or contouring, while Sculptra focuses on long-term collagen support. Many treatment plans include both for balanced, customized results.⁠
⁠
